previous_statement: For every y in B_s, the cutoff bound 0<=chi(y)<=1 gives ||chi(y)Ay||<=||A||||y||<||A||s<R, so kappa(chi(y)Ay) is defined. On the annular neighbourhood where chi=0 this formula equals kappa(0)=p, the outside formula; hence the two smooth local formulas agree on an open neighbourhood of the patch boundary and glue to a smooth global G. On B_r, chi=1, so kappa^{-1} composed with G composed with kappa is y->Ay.
new_statement: For every y in B_s, the cutoff bound 0<=chi(y)<=1 gives ||chi(y)Ay||<=||A||||y||<=||A||s<R, so kappa(chi(y)Ay) is defined; the weak middle inequality is valid also when A=0. On the annular neighbourhood where chi=0 this formula equals kappa(0)=p, the outside formula; hence the two smooth local formulas agree on an open neighbourhood of the patch boundary and glue to a smooth global G. On B_r, chi=1, so kappa^{-1} composed with G composed with kappa is y->Ay.
